scope: Twelve free chart types; no Pro components or animated-counter. Values are upstream evidence, not global Zero theme defaults.
mapping: Semantic paint: private --zero-arc-* → --zero-chart-* → Zero. Arc foundation is inventoried but never installed globally.
referenceNotation: --series-{1..4} denotes a dynamic source palette reference, not a literal custom-property name.

declarations.name: --series-1
declarations.value: oklch(from var(--accent) calc(l * sign(max(c - .02, 0)) + .58 * (1 - sign(max(c - .02, 0)))) calc(c * sign(max(c - .02, 0)) + .15 * (1 - sign(max(c - .02, 0)))) calc(h * sign(max(c - .02, 0)) + 250 * (1 - sign(max(c - .02, 0)))))
